ja_pron: 24 sekki o tsukuri, kodai Chūgoku no nōgyō o kanri suru tame ni tsukaware mashita.

native: Towards the end of September, it's the autumn equinox time.

zh: 新天地。
ja: 新しい場所を楽しみます。
local: a new place.
ja_pron: Atarashii basho o tanoshimimasu.
native: a new place.

zh: 秋分是秋季的中點，標誌著深秋的開始。
ja: 秋分は秋の真ん中で、深い秋の始まりを示します。
local: The autumn equinox is midway through autumn and marks the beginning of deepest autumn.
ja_pron: Shūbun wa aki no mannaka de, fukai aki no hajimari o shimeshimasu.
native: The autumn equinox is midway through autumn and marks the beginning of deepest autumn.

en: oil painting.
zh: 油畫中。
ja: 油絵の中にいるかのようです。
local: oil painting.
ja_pron: Aburae no naka ni iru ka no yō desu.
native: oil painting.

en: After this solar term, there's no more thunder.
zh: 這個節氣過後，就不再有雷聲。
ja: この節気の後は雷が鳴らなくなります。
local: After this solar term, there's no more thunder.
ja_pron: Kono sekki no ato wa kaminari ga naranaku narimasu.
native: After this solar term, there's no more thunder.

en: The insects that woke up in the third solar term dinghir are either dying or looking for
zh: 在第三個節氣醒來的昆蟲，要麼正在死亡，要麼在尋找
ja: 第三の節気で目覚めた昆虫たちは、死にかけているか、または

native: The insects that woke up in the third solar term dinghir are either dying or looking for

en: a safe place to survive the winter.
zh: 一個安全的地方來度過冬天。
ja: 冬を越すための安全な場所を探しています。
local: a safe place to survive the winter.
ja_pron: Fuyu o kosu tame no anzen na basho o sagashite imasu.
native: a safe place to survive the winter.

en: Sunhuang is in northwestern China, a transitional region between Bajangarang and Taklamakan
zh: 敦煌位於中國西北部，是巴揚加朗和塔克拉瑪干之間的過渡區域，
ja: 敦煌は中国の北西部にあり、バジャンガラン砂漠とタクラマカン砂漠の間の移行地域です。
local: Sunhuang is in northwestern China, a transitional region between Bajangarang and Taklamakan
ja_pron: Dunhuang wa Chūgoku no hokuseibu ni ari, Bajangarang sabaku to Takurakukan sabaku no aida no ikō chiiki desu.
native: Sunhuang is in northwestern China, a transitional region between Bajangarang and Taklamakan

en: deserts.
zh: 沙漠。
ja: 砂漠です。
local: deserts.
ja_pron: Sabaku desu.
native: deserts.

en: It used to be on the main thoroughfare of the Silk Road Trade Route.
zh: 它曾是絲綢之路貿易路線的主要通道。
ja: かつてはシルクロード貿易ルートの主要な幹線道路でした。
local: It used to be on the main thoroughfare of the Silk Road Trade Route.
ja_pron: Katsute wa Shirukurodo bōeki rūto no shuyō na kansen dōro deshita.
native: It used to be on the main thoroughfare of the Silk Road Trade Route.

en: I came over here for autumn equinox solar term to explore deep into the hinterland of China
zh: 我來到這裡，為了秋分節氣，深入中國內陸探險，
ja: 秋分の節気のためにここに来て、中国の奥地を探検します。
local: I came over here for autumn equinox solar term to explore deep into the hinterland of China
ja_pron: Shūbun no sekki no tame ni koko ni kite, Chūgoku no okuchi o tanken shimasu.
native: I came over here for autumn equinox solar term to explore deep into the hinterland of China

en: and take in this incredible desert oasis.
zh: 並欣賞這個令人難以置信的沙漠綠洲。
ja: そしてこの信じられない砂漠のオアシスを楽しみます。
local: and take in this incredible desert oasis.
ja_pron: Soshite kono shinjirarenai sabaku no oashisu o tanoshimimasu.
native: and take in this incredible desert oasis.

en: You can imagine that ever since the hand dynasty of 2,200 years ago, European businessmen
zh: 你可以想像，從2200年前的漢朝開始，歐洲商人

local: You can imagine that ever since the hand dynasty of 2,200 years ago, European businessmen

native: You can imagine that ever since the hand dynasty of 2,200 years ago, European businessmen

en: looking a bit like me have been here leading teams of camel transporting bundles of silk
zh: 看起來有點像我這樣的人，一直在這裡帶領駱駝隊運送絲綢包裹，
ja: 私に少し似た人々がここでラクダの隊を率いて絹の束を運んでいます。
local: looking a bit like me have been here leading teams of camel transporting bundles of silk
ja_pron: Watashi ni sukoshi nita hitobito ga koko de rakuda no tai o hikiite kinu no taba o hakonde imasu.
native: looking a bit like me have been here leading teams of camel transporting bundles of silk

en: and other material from China around the world.
zh: 以及其他物資從中國運往世界各地。
ja: そして他の物資も中国から世界中へ運ばれています。
local: and other material from China around the world.
ja_pron: Soshite hoka no busshi mo Chūgoku kara sekaijū e hakobarete imasu.
native: and other material from China around the world.

en: Massive wealth flowed along the Silk Road to China as well.
zh: 大量財富也沿著絲綢之路流入中國。
ja: 莫大な富もシルクロードを通って中国に流れ込みました。
local: Massive wealth flowed along the Silk Road to China as well.
ja_pron: Bokudai na tomi mo Shirukurodo o tōtte Chūgoku ni nagarekomimashita.
native: Massive wealth flowed along the Silk Road to China as well.

en: China at the time was one of the chief trading nations of the world.
zh: 當時的中國是世界主要的貿易國之一。
ja: 当時の中国は世界の主要な貿易国の一つでした。
local: China at the time was one of the chief trading nations of the world.
ja_pron: Tōji no Chūgoku wa sekai no shuyō na bōeki-koku no hitotsu deshita.
native: China at the time was one of the chief trading nations of the world.

native: Now Dunhuang has lost its pivotal positioning global trade, but this goby desert is still

en: a sacred place for Chinese people yearning for a distant past.
zh: 是中國人懷念遙遠過去的神聖之地。
ja: 遠い過去を懐かしむ中国人にとって神聖な場所です。
local: a sacred place for Chinese people yearning for a distant past.
ja_pron: Tōi kako o natsukashimu Chūgokujin ni totte shinsei na basho desu.
native: a sacred place for Chinese people yearning for a distant past.

en: There's a rhyming couplet for this season when days and nights are just as long hard work
zh: 這個季節有一句押韻的對聯，白天和黑夜一樣長，辛勤工作
ja: この季節には、昼と夜が同じ長さで、懸命に働くことを詠んだ韻文があります。
local: There's a rhyming couplet for this season when days and nights are just as long hard work
ja_pron: Kono kisetsu ni wa, hiru to yoru ga onaji nagasa de, kenmei ni hataraku koto o yonda inbun ga arimasu.
native: There's a rhyming couplet for this season when days and nights are just as long hard work

en: just goes on and on.
zh: 不斷持續。
ja: ずっと続きます。
local: just goes on and on.
ja_pron: Zutto tsuzukimasu.
native: just goes on and on.

zh: 長期的循環是農民的首要關注，因此節氣對他們來說非常重要，

zh: 在規劃上非常明確，秋分被定為敦煌農民收割的時節，
ja: 計画において非常に明確であり、秋分は敦煌の農民が収穫する時期とされています。
local: clear on planning and it is set that autumn equinox is when Dunhuang farmers will harvest
ja_pron: Keikaku ni oite hijō ni meikaku de ari, shūbun wa Dunhuang no nōmin ga shūkaku suru jiki to sarete imasu.
native: clear on planning and it is set that autumn equinox is when Dunhuang farmers will harvest

en: their cotton.
zh: 他們的棉花。
ja: 彼らの綿花です。
local: their cotton.
ja_pron: Karera no menka desu.
native: their cotton.

en: Dunhuang is surrounded by desert, so drought and water shortage is pretty common.
zh: 敦煌被沙漠包圍，因此乾旱和缺水相當普遍。
ja: 敦煌は砂漠に囲まれているため、干ばつや水不足がかなり一般的です。
local: Dunhuang is surrounded by desert, so drought and water shortage is pretty common.
ja_pron: Dunhuang wa sabaku ni kakomarete iru tame, kanbatsu ya mizubusoku ga kanari ippanteki desu.
native: Dunhuang is surrounded by desert, so drought and water shortage is pretty common.

en: Because of or in spite of this, it has become an important base for cotton production.
zh: 正因如此，這裡成為了重要的棉花生產基地。
ja: このため、あるいはそれにもかかわらず、ここは重要な綿花生産基地となっています。
local: Because of or in spite of this, it has become an important base for cotton production.
ja_pron: Kono tame, aruiwa sore ni mo kakawarazu, koko wa jūyō na menka seisan kichi to natte imasu.
native: Because of or in spite of this, it has become an important base for cotton production.

en: This makes me think back to the Xiaoman solar term in Shenzhen where there was copious
zh: 這讓我想起深圳的小滿節氣，那裡有大量的
ja: これで深圳の小満の節気を思い出します。そこでは豊富な
local: This makes me think back to the Xiaoman solar term in Shenzhen where there was copious
ja_pron: Kore de Shenzhen no Shōman no sekki o omoidashimasu. Soko de wa hōfu na
native: This makes me think back to the Xiaoman solar term in Shenzhen where there was copious

zh: 雨水充沛，蠶蟲茁壯，促成了整個絲綢產業。
ja: 雨が豊富で、蚕が繁栄し、絹の生産産業全体を育てました。
local: amounts of rain and the silkworms thrived, raising a whole industry of silk production.
ja_pron: Ame ga hōfu de, kaiko ga han'ei shi, kinu no seisan sangyō zentai o sodate mashita.
native: amounts of rain and the silkworms thrived, raising a whole industry of silk production.

en: Such differences in regional climate have not limited Chinese creativity over time.
zh: 這種區域氣候的差異並未限制中國人的創造力。
ja: 地域ごとの気候の違いは、中国の創造力を制限していません。
local: Such differences in regional climate have not limited Chinese creativity over time.
ja_pron: Chiiki goto no kikō no chigai wa, Chūgoku no sōzōryoku o seigen shite imasen.
native: Such differences in regional climate have not limited Chinese creativity over time.

en: The thousands of years, silk and cotton have warmed the backs of Chinese people in different
zh: 數千年來，絲綢和棉花溫暖了中國不同地區人民的背部，

native: The thousands of years, silk and cotton have warmed the backs of Chinese people in different

en: parts of this vast land.
zh: 這片廣大土地的不同部分。
ja: この広大な土地の異なる部分で。
local: parts of this vast land.
ja_pron: Kono kōdai na tochi no kotonaru bubun de.
native: parts of this vast land.

en: Their inventions lie in a key climatic difference between north and south.
zh: 他們的發明根據於南北之間的關鍵氣候差異。
ja: 彼らの発明は南北の重要な気候の違いに基づいています。
local: Their inventions lie in a key climatic difference between north and south.
ja_pron: Karera no hatsumei wa nanboku no jūyō na kikō no chigai ni motozuite imasu.
native: Their inventions lie in a key climatic difference between north and south.

en: This is one of the most important cotton production sites in China.
zh: 這是中國最重要的棉花生產地之一。
ja: ここは中国で最も重要な綿花生産地の一つです。
local: This is one of the most important cotton production sites in China.
ja_pron: Koko wa Chūgoku de mottomo jūyō na menka seisan chi no hitotsu desu.
native: This is one of the most important cotton production sites in China.

en: And it is also the largest coloured cotton testing station in the country.
zh: 同時也是國內最大的彩色棉花測試站。
ja: また、国内最大のカラードコットン試験場でもあります。
local: And it is also the largest coloured cotton testing station in the country.
ja_pron: Mata, kokunai saidai no karādo kotton shikenjō demo arimasu.
native: And it is also the largest coloured cotton testing station in the country.

en: The autumn equinox is harvest season in the water-rich regions of China.
zh: 秋分是中國水資源豐富地區的收穫季節。
ja: 秋分は中国の水資源が豊富な地域の収穫期です。
local: The autumn equinox is harvest season in the water-rich regions of China.
ja_pron: Shūbun wa Chūgoku no suishigen ga hōfu na chiiki no shūkaku-ki desu.
native: The autumn equinox is harvest season in the water-rich regions of China.

zh: 農民們現在正在收割稻米和水果，但在敦煌，看看
ja: 農民たちは今頃、米や果物を収穫していますが、敦煌では、見てください、

ja_pron: Nōmin-tachi wa imagoro, kome ya kudamono o shūkaku shite imasu ga, Dunhuang de wa, mite kudasai,
native: Farmers are harvesting rice and fruit around about now, but in Dunhuang, just look at

en: the full light cotton balls that grow on this cracked and salty soil.
zh: 這些在龜裂且鹹鹹的土壤上生長的飽滿棉花球。
ja: ひび割れた塩分の多い土壌で育つふっくらとした綿の実を。
local: the full light cotton balls that grow on this cracked and salty soil.
ja_pron: Hibiwareta enbun no ōi dojo de sodatsu fukkura to shita men no mi o.
native: the full light cotton balls that grow on this cracked and salty soil.

en: You have to wonder at the plant's tenacity and how ancient civilizations across China
zh: 你不得不驚嘆這植物的韌性，以及古代中國文明如何
ja: この植物の粘り強さと、古代中国の文明がどのように
local: You have to wonder at the plant's tenacity and how ancient civilizations across China
ja_pron: Kono shokubutsu no nebari tsuyosa to, kodai Chūgoku no bunmei ga dono yō ni
native: You have to wonder at the plant's tenacity and how ancient civilizations across China

zh: 適應當地環境。
ja: 地域の環境に適応したかを考えざるを得ません。
local: adapted to local conditions.
ja_pron: Chiiki no kankyō ni tekiō shita ka o kangae zaru o emasen.
native: adapted to local conditions.

en: Having said that, cotton doesn't actually come from here.
zh: 話雖如此，棉花其實不是來自這裡。
ja: とはいえ、綿は実際にはここから来たものではありません。
local: Having said that, cotton doesn't actually come from here.
ja_pron: To wa ie, men wa jissai ni wa koko kara kita mono de wa arimasen.
native: Having said that, cotton doesn't actually come from here.

en: Once in 1,500 years ago, it was brought into the country by Camel Caravan, trundling
zh: 大約1500年前，棉花是由駱駝商隊帶入國內，緩緩前行，
ja: 約1500年前、ラクダの隊商によって国内に運ばれました。
local: Once in 1,500 years ago, it was brought into the country by Camel Caravan, trundling
ja_pron: Yaku 1500 nen mae, rakuda no taishō ni yotte kokunai ni hakobaremashita.
native: Once in 1,500 years ago, it was brought into the country by Camel Caravan, trundling

en: along the Silk Road, introduced to Dunhuang from India and Arabia.
zh: 沿著絲綢之路，從印度和阿拉伯引入敦煌。
ja: シルクロードを通り、インドやアラビアから敦煌に紹介されました。
local: along the Silk Road, introduced to Dunhuang from India and Arabia.
ja_pron: Shirukurodo o tōri, Indo ya Arabia kara Dunhuang ni shōkai saremashita.

ja: 砂と汗の道を行き、信じられないほどの品物を運び、困難に遭遇しながら
local: Trading the sand sweat paths, carrying the most incredible goods, encountering hardships
native: Trading the sand sweat paths, carrying the most incredible goods, encountering hardships

en: and obstacles, travelling from grotto to grotto, they brought riches to Dunhuang.
zh: 克服障礙，從石窟到石窟旅行，他們為敦煌帶來了財富。
ja: 障害を乗り越え、石窟から石窟へ旅し、敦煌に富をもたらしました。
local: and obstacles, travelling from grotto to grotto, they brought riches to Dunhuang.
native: and obstacles, travelling from grotto to grotto, they brought riches to Dunhuang.

en: You made this the place to do business at the autumn equinox solar term.
zh: 你們讓這裡成為秋分節氣做生意的地方。
ja: あなたたちはここを秋分の節気に商売をする場所にしました。
local: You made this the place to do business at the autumn equinox solar term.
native: You made this the place to do business at the autumn equinox solar term.

en: The smell of yellow sand has accompanied civilization through the millennia.
zh: 黃沙的氣味伴隨著文明走過千年。
ja: 黄色い砂の匂いは何千年もの間文明と共にありました。
local: The smell of yellow sand has accompanied civilization through the millennia.
native: The smell of yellow sand has accompanied civilization through the millennia.

en: Here, I've seen the power and tenacity of life in the desert.
zh: 在這裡，我看到了沙漠中生命的力量與韌性。
ja: ここで、私は砂漠の中の生命の力と粘り強さを見ました。
local: Here, I've seen the power and tenacity of life in the desert.
native: Here, I've seen the power and tenacity of life in the desert.
